MyFundedPerpetuals provides access to simulated perpetual futures contract evaluation and funded accounts intended for skill demonstration and performance-evaluation purposes only.

Simulated Environment - No Real Capital, No Live Trading

All accounts offered through MyFundedPerpetuals, including both Evaluation Accounts and Simulated Funded Accounts, operate exclusively within a simulated, non-executing environment. No program offered by MyFundedPerpetuals involves the deposit, use, or risk of real capital, and no participant is ever asked to fund a live trading account through MyFundedPerpetuals. MyFundedPerpetuals does not currently offer, and makes no representation that it will in the future offer, any pathway to trading with real capital or to a live funded account. Should a participant separately choose to trade real-money perpetual futures contracts or other derivative instruments on any third-party platform, that activity occurs entirely outside the scope of MyFundedPerpetuals and is not facilitated, brokered, or in any way enabled by MyFundedPerpetuals.

Reference Pricing - No Affiliation with Referenced Exchanges

Simulated pricing and settlement within MyFundedPerpetuals' Evaluation and Simulated Funded Accounts are modeled by reference to publicly available data from third-party exchanges, including Hyperliquid, Binance, and Bybit, depending on the instrument being simulated. MyFundedPerpetuals is not affiliated with, sponsored by, endorsed by, or otherwise connected to Hyperliquid, Binance, Bybit, or their respective operators. References to these platforms exist solely to approximate realistic simulated market conditions; MyFundedPerpetuals' simulated accounts are not connected to, and do not interact with, any real account, order book, or funds on Hyperliquid, Binance, Bybit, or any other exchange.

Permitted Instrument Categories

Participants may simulate trading perpetual futures contracts across the following categories: (i) cryptocurrencies; (ii) indices; (iii) foreign exchange (FX); (iv) stocks; and (v) commodities. MyFundedPerpetuals reserves the right to modify, add, or remove available categories at its sole discretion and without notice.

Simulated Evaluation and Funded Environment Purpose and Limitations

MyFundedPerpetuals' Evaluation and Simulated Funded Account programs are conducted entirely through demo accounts within a simulated, non-executing environment. These accounts do not involve the entry of orders or execution of actual trades in any live market, and do not expose participants to true market conditions such as slippage, execution latency, funding rate fluctuations, liquidation dynamics, capital constraints, or the psychological pressures of live trading. While MyFundedPerpetuals' simulated environment is designed to approximate real market conditions as closely as reasonably practicable, it does not constitute participation in an actual live market, and all gains and losses produced within it are hypothetical only.

Payout eligibility in the Simulated Funded Account stage is subject to rules compliance, risk thresholds, trading requirements, and firm review as set out in the Trader Agreement.
